settings.body:

Loculens keeps every branch separate, so the outlier is the first thing you see, not the last thing you find out.

settings.q: Which review sites does Loculens read?
settings.a:
Google only.
Most multi-location businesses get the bulk of their public reviews there, and one source read properly beats six read badly.
Reviews arrive through your Google Business Profile once you connect it, or through a scraping run you control and pay for per review.

settings.q: Does it post replies for me?
settings.a:
No.
It drafts a reply in your own voice, measured from the replies you have already posted, and opens the right Google panel.
A person reads it and presses send.
Nothing goes out without someone looking at it.

settings.q: How does it know who was mentioned?
settings.a:
You keep a roster of your team.
Loculens matches names in review text against that roster, whole word and case-insensitive.
It proposes new names it keeps seeing so you can confirm or dismiss them.
It never guesses a name into your leaderboard.

Syncs are incremental.
Each run asks only for reviews newer than the last one, so a routine sync costs cents.
You see the month's spend in the footer.
A monthly cap stops runaway costs, and you can bill scraping to your own Apify account if you prefer.

settings.q: Can head office see every branch while a manager sees one?
settings.a:
Yes.
Every location sits in one workspace with per-location counts and filters.
Members you invite see the shared data.
Admins manage the roster, the connections and the plan.
Separate businesses get separate workspaces and never see each other.

Fourteen days, no card.
Create a workspace, add your locations, run a sync and read your own reviews before you decide.
